target_text: // An odd stride is coprime with 64, so the scrambled order visits every token once.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The formula restates line 137, which spells it with the named constants. What the code does not say is why 37 is a valid stride: an odd stride modulo 64 is a permutation, so every token is stored once.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // An odd stride is coprime with 64, so the scrambled order visits every token once.
```
